page_title: DOR 4-0 DAR | Dortmund v Darmstadt 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Daniel Siebert is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' The attendance is 81365.
88' 4 - 0 Goal! Donyell Malen (Dortmund) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 4:0.
88' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
87' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt).
85' Substitution. Klaus Gjasula did his best and is replaced by Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt).
82' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) replaces Marco Reus.
80' Emre Can (Dortmund) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
78' A pass into the box finds Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marcel Schuhen denies him.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt) replaces Tim Skarke.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund.
76' Wow, what an escape. Donyell Malen (Dortmund) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Dortmund get a corner.
74' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
73' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Julian Ryerson is replaced by Marius Wolf (Dortmund).
73' Here comes a substitution. Jadon Sancho is given a rest as he is replaced by Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund).
72' 3 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Jadon Sancho sets up Julian Brandt (Dortmund) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:0.

69' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marcel Schuhen pulls off an easy save.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Poppler Isherwood is coming onto the pitch as Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) replacing Marvin Mehlem.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) for Oscar Vilhelmsson.
65' Emre Can (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcel Schuhen intercepts the ball.
64' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.

63' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.

62' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Gregor Kobel!

62' Excellent touch by Donyell Malen (Dortmund)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
61' Here is a change. Niclas Fullkrug is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Adeyemi departs the field of play to be replaced by Donyell Malen (Dortmund).

60' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Marcel Schuhen anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
59' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
58' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Marcel Schuhen comfortably gathers the ball.
57' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

56' Marco Reus (Dortmund) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His effort towards the left post is stopped by Marcel Schuhen, who pulls off a glorious save! Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Siebert signals a foul. Dortmund have a free kick from a promising distance.
55' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
53' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar.
52' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Marco Reus (Dortmund), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
52' Marco Reus (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
50' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
48' Marco Reus (Dortmund) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
48' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.
46' The whistle blows and Daniel Siebert starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Matthias Bader slings over a decent looking cross towards Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.
45+2' The corner from Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is cleared away by the defence.
45+1' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
43' Marco Reus (Dortmund) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
41' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) tries to find Marcel Sabitzer, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
41' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) tries to find Marco Reus with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
38' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Marco Reus (Dortmund) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. The ball ends up inside the left post. Superb strike!
37' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Dortmund earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
36' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

35' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Marcel Schuhen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
34' Marco Reus (Dortmund) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
34' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) passes the ball onto Oscar Vilhelmsson, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.

30' 1 - 0 Brilliant finish! Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Marco Reus, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
30' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
29' Marco Reus (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' 2:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
22' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' The resulting corner from Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
20' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes the corner which is cleared. Dortmund have a corner.
19' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner.
17' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
16' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) was first to the rebound after it had fallen to him from the corner and smashes the ball not far wide of the left post.
16' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

15' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Darmstadt will have a corner.
14' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
12' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' A great pass puts Marco Reus (Dortmund) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
10' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
7' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
7' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) gets booked for the first time in this match.
3' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) tries to find Karim Adeyemi, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
2' Tobias Kempe bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
2' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
2' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Darmstadt earn a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Darmstadt will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
